system.description:
• Effect: Aura of Courage: you are immune to the Frightened and Terrified conditions. Allies within your aura have Advantage on saves against fear. The aura reaches 10ft, 30ft from 15th and 50ft from 20th (see the Paladin Progression Table).
  • Aura of Devotion (9th): an ally in your aura who is Frightened or Charmed saves again at the start of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
  • Aura of Resolve (15th): you and allies in your aura have Advantage on saves against Paralysed and Stunned.

rules.when: against being Paralysed or Stunned (you and allies in your Aura of Courage)

rules.value: Aura of Devotion: if you are Frightened or Charmed, save again at the start of each of your turns, ending it on a success.
rules.label: Aura of Devotion
